data.name: Disrupting Counter
data.description: When an opponent makes a melee attack against her, she can spend 1 panache point to make an attack of opportunity against the attacking foe. This attack of opportunity can be made with either a dagger or a starknife. If the attack hits, the opponent takes a -4 penalty on all attack rolls until the end of its turn. This deed replaces kip-up.
